metadata.description: Generic Claude Code plugins for AI engineering workflows. Sole plugin since v4.0.0: learn-kit — pedagogical kit. v6.0.0 BREAKING: learn-kit consolidates from 5 skills (scaffold-learning / locate / scan / generate-tier / nlm-studio) into single `three-views` skill that generates 3-tier learning markdown (foundation / structural / challenge) from sources (project files / external URL via WebFetch / pasted text via source_manifest tracking), then optionally renders interactive HTML (dual-mode grounding: repo-code via Explore subagent or source-evidence) and/or pushes to NotebookLM for max 10 multimedia artifacts (audio/video/slide_deck × 3 views = 9 + 1 shared mind_map; infographic permanently retired). Preserves all nlm-studio dogfood防护 (per-step auth refresh / source validation / 4-way re-run guard / quota right-sizing gate / bounded polling). Migrate `/learn-kit:generate-tier` → `/learn-kit:three-views`; `/learn-kit:nlm-studio` → `/learn-kit:three-views` Step 4 select NLM. See [ADR]_LearnKit_Consolidation_To_Single_Skill.md + Migration_From_v3_to_v4 §6 for full walkthrough. v4.1.0 adds 19 project-local mp-* workflow skills under .claude/skills/. v4.2.0+ introduces marketplace documentation framework (currently v1.6: 6 tag prefixes + 8-field frontmatter + 3-state machine + 5 root-level named files codification + §2.7 CLAUDE.md sync allowlist + §4.3.1 A6 active CI gate).

plugins.name: learn-kit
plugins.description: Pedagogical kit. Single skill `three-views` (v3.0.0 BREAKING consolidation; replaces v2.x's 5-skill setup): given a topic + source material (project files / external URL / pasted text), generates 3-tier learning markdown (foundation 零基础版 / structural 结构版 / challenge 挑战版); then opt-in renders interactive HTML (dual-mode grounding: concept→code via Explore subagent when source is project files; concept→source-section when source is URL/text) and/or pushes to NotebookLM for max 10 multimedia artifacts (audio + video + slide_deck × 3 views = 9 view-cycled + 1 shared view-agnostic mind_map; infographic permanently retired). NLM portion preserves nlm-studio dogfood防护: per-step refresh_auth, real auth gate via notebook_list, source_add validation via notebook_get, 4-way re-run guard, quota right-sizing 4-way gate, bounded polling 12×10s. Requires notebooklm-mcp MCP server (bundled) + one-time `nlm login` only when NLM opt-in is selected. v3.0.0 BREAKING: removed 4 skills (`/learn-kit:scaffold-learning`, `/learn-kit:locate`, `/learn-kit:scan`, `/learn-kit:nlm-studio`); renamed `/learn-kit:generate-tier` → `/learn-kit:three-views`. locate/scan algorithms preserved as manual recipes in plugin-internal [GUIDE]_LearnKit_Discovery_Recipes.md.
